name: @pipeworx/mcp-visa-requirements

tools.name: visa_requirement
tools.description: Do I need a visa? Visa requirement for one passport (nationality) traveling to one destination country — returns visa-free (with allowed stay days when known), visa on arrival, e-visa, eTA, visa required, or no admission. Covers 199×199 country pairs. Data: community-maintained Passport Index snapshot (last updated 2026-02-18) — verify with official sources before travel. Example: visa_requirement({ passport: "United States", destination: "Brazil" })

passport.description: Passport / nationality — ISO2, ISO3, or country name, e.g. "US", "DEU", "South Korea", "UK"

destination.description: Destination country — ISO2, ISO3, or country name, e.g. "BR", "Japan", "Türkiye"

tools.name: visa_free_destinations
tools.description: Where can holders of a given passport travel without a visa? Lists every destination grouped by requirement: visa-free (with allowed stay days), visa on arrival, e-visa, eTA — plus counts for visa-required and no-admission. Optional filter to a single category. Answers "visa-free countries for X passport holders". Data: Passport Index snapshot (2026-02-18). Example: visa_free_destinations({ passport: "Germany" })

passport.description: Passport / nationality — ISO2, ISO3, or country name

requirement.description: Optional: return only destinations in this category (default: full lists for visa_free, visa_on_arrival, e_visa, eta, plus counts for the rest)

tools.name: visa_passport_compare
tools.description: Compare passport power: for 2-5 passports, how many destinations each can enter visa-free / on arrival / with e-visa or eTA / visa required (passport-ranking mobility comparison). With exactly 2 passports, also lists destinations where the requirements differ (up to 30). Data: Passport Index snapshot (2026-02-18). Example: visa_passport_compare({ passports: ["US", "India"] })

passports.description: 2-5 passports to compare — ISO2, ISO3, or country names, e.g. ["US", "IN"] or ["Germany", "Japan", "Singapore"]

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-visa-requirements forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the visa-requirements pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
